ABOLISHING THE COUNCIL FOR INVESTMENTS.
The Council for Investments
in Trade, Industry,
Tourism, Agriculture,
Transportation,
Communications
created pursuant to EO 136, s. 1987, is hereby abolished.

REFOCUSING AND STRENGTHENING THE OSAC.
The Investment One-Stop Action Center of the Board of Investments,
created pursuant
hereby refocused to provide
facilitation and problem-solving
services to investors.
The OSAC is also
hereby strengthened through a more coordinated mechanism to provide
comprehensive
service delivery to investors
and a more responsive
organization to address investor concems.

as clearing house for potential investors and undertake due diligence on
the capabilities
of potential investors.
